concept.title: The Museum of Borrowed Shadows
concept.description: A sunlit gallery where sculptural shadows seem to have lives of their own. The heroine moves through a quiet exchange between her body, the architecture, and pools of cobalt shade, with warm wine-red cloth recurring against pale stone.
concept.heroine: A 32-year-old adult woman with warm brown skin, a heart-shaped face, short sculpted black curls, hazel eyes, and a fine scar through her left eyebrow. Her main outfit is a wine-red one-shoulder crepe jumpsuit with a narrow brass waist clasp and straight full-length legs.

frames.summary: She stands beneath a high gallery arch as her long shadow reaches across a sunlit wall, seen in a front waist-up composition.
